message-summarize is MIT-licensed. It uses the production dependencies below (direct and transitive), each under
its own license. Development tools are not listed because they are not distributed.

## License exceptions

These dependencies are outside the license allowlist and are reported on purpose (RNF-18).

- **libsignal@6.0.0** (GPL-3.0): Dependency of Baileys, the WhatsApp adapter. Incompatible with an MIT distribution: decide before v0.1.0 (replace, isolate or relicense), RNF-18 in docs/requirements.md requires compatible licenses. Blocks 'npm publish': prepublishOnly runs check-licenses with --strict, which rejects every exception.
